sn18.11:1.3: Atha kho āyasmā Rāhulo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantam Rāhulaṃ Bhagavā etad avoca || || 3
sn18.11:1.5: Cakkhuṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn18.11:1.7: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukham vāti || ||
sn18.11:1.9: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu tam samanupassituṃ
sn18.11:1.10: Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attā ti || ||
sn18.11:1.16: Mano nicco va anicco vā ti || ||
sn18.11:1.18: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā tam sukhaṃ vā ti || ||
sn18.11:1.20: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu tam samanupassituṃ
sn18.11:1.21: Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti || ||
sn18.11:1.23: Evam passaṃ Rāhula sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmim pi nibbindati || sotasmim pi || ghānasmim pi || jivhāya pi || kāyasmim pi || manasmim pi nibbindati || || 22
sn18.11:1.24: Nibbindaṃ virajjati || virāgā vimuccati || vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti || ||
sn18.11:1.25: Khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
